text:
deploy-bot: :warning: Release paused — env parity check failed for inference-config keys between staging and prod. Blocking tag: v2.14.1

maya: saw the alert, quick summary — staging config map has `INFER_CACHE_PATH` and prod has `inferCachePath`. deploycheck flagged mismatch.

ton y: ugh casing diffs again. where is that key coming from? infra templates or app defaults?

samira: looks like the helm values generator in infra-tools normalizes keys differently depending on --set vs values.yaml. I saw a PR last week that touched normalizeKeys.

irene: can we hotfix by adding a migration in release pipeline to canonicalize env keys? or easier: pin the canary to use staging variant until we fix templating.

maya: quick debug log from deploycheck: ```
FAILED: env-parity-check
staging:/etc/config/inference.env -> INFER_CACHE_PATH=/mnt/cache/prefix
prod:/etc/config/inference.env -> inferCachePath=/mnt/cache/prefix
Diff: key name mismatch only
```

tony: if it's only name case, app code reads both variants (we added fallback last quarter) but some sidecars (metrics exporter) only read exact key. Risk: metrics and cache TTLs won't align in prod.

samira: proposed options: 1) roll back the normalizeKeys change in infra-tools and re-render values (fast), 2) patch sidecar to accept both keys (code change, needs test), 3) add release pipeline step to inject a compat env var on prod (short-lived).

irene: prefer option 3 to unblock release now. Add a follow-up ticket to fix infra-tools and sidecar.

maya: +1 for 3. Samira, can you prepare the pipeline patch? I can own the follow-up infra PR.

samira: pinging the release window owner: @tony are we still in the 18:00-20:00 change window?

ton y: yes change window open until 19:30. if we do pipeline patch we should smash it through canary then prod.

deploy-bot: recorded action: release v2.14.1 paused at 3198765432. tags: env-parity, hotpatch-request. Assigned: samira, maya.

samira: I'll open a tiny pipeline commit to add a step that injects `INFER_CACHE_PATH=${inferCachePath:-$INFER_CACHE_PATH}` into the rendered env map for prod. pushing in 10.

maya: thanks — once the patch is green we'll re-run deploycheck. If it passes, canary then promote.

irene: filing follow-ups: INFRA-1128 (normalizeKeys revert investigation), SIDE-459 (metrics-sidecar env fallback).

tony: note for release notes: mention transient compatibility fix and planned infra-side proper fix in next maintenance window.

samira: pushed pipeline patch, CI running -> will update. :rocket:
